faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 18 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies: 1 Ayurveda Doctor, 1 Ayurveda Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for ECHS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: By email to [email protected], on or before 18 November 2026. There is no online form.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post - Ayurveda Doctor: 66 years for employment, 68 years for service; Ayurveda Pharmacist: 56 years for employment, 58 years for service.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: 95000 for Ayurveda Doctor, 36500 for Ayurveda Pharmacist.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Ayurveda Doctor: BAMS degree recognized by NCISM, valid registration, minimum 03 years of experience after internship. Ayurveda Pharmacist: B. Pharma or D. Pharma (Ayurveda) recognized by Central/State Govt, valid registration in the concerned State/UT, minimum 03 years of experience. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Ayurveda Doctor must hold valid registration with national commission for Indian system of medicine or equivalent state medicine board/council. Ayurveda Pharmacist must hold valid registration as per extant provisions/regulations in the concerned State/UT. Only candidates meeting Qualitative Requirements may apply.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interview (candidates meeting the QR will be intimated the place, date and time later). Candidates meeting the QR will be intimated the place, date and time of interview later. Original documents must be brought for the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Contractual basis for a period of one year. Renewable for additional period of one year/till attaining the maximum age subject to performance of candidates/other conditions.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the posting for this recruitment?
faq.answer: ECHS Polyclinic Danapur.
